message: A ten-second AI video costs about a dollar to make and a local business pays hundreds for it — three steps to your first paying client

lines.text: A ten second AI video costs you about a dollar, and the restaurant down your street pays three hundred for it.
Screenshot their best dish from their own Instagram.
Drop it into Seedance and ask for a slow push in with steam rising.
Send it to the owner free and ask if they want three more.
One yes pays your month. Comment VIDEO for the prompt.
